_metadata.description: Machine-readable detection catalog for the Huntsman Search Engine (HSE). Structured form of hunt-queries.md (H-*) and correlation-and-coverage.md (C-*/B-*/A-*). Queries are KQL scaffolds to tune per environment; the .md files carry full context.

detections.name: Illicit OAuth app consent
detections.summary: OAuth token theft via malicious app consent to high-privilege mail/file scopes.
detections.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName in ("Consent to application","Add delegated permission grant") | mv-expand mp=TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties | extend perms=tostring(mp.newValue) | where perms has_any ("Mail.Read","Mail.ReadWrite","Files.ReadWrite.All","full_access_as_app")
detections.tuning: Allow-list known internal apps; alert on high-privilege mail/file scopes.

detections.name: Credential added to service principal
detections.summary: Adversary adds a secret/cert to an app registration to persist in the cloud.
detections.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName in ("Add service principal credentials","Update application - Certificates and secrets management")
detections.tuning: Correlate with whether the actor normally manages app credentials.

detections.name: MFA fatigue / push bombing
detections.summary: Repeated MFA denials followed by a success = the user gave up and approved.
detections.query: SigninLogs | where ResultType in ("500121","50074") | summarize denied=count() by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated,10m) | where denied >= 5   // then join to a success within 15m
detections.tuning: The deny-then-approve within 15m is the strong signal, not denials alone.

detections.name: New MFA device / security-info registration
detections.summary: After a help-desk-vished reset, the attacker registers their own MFA device.
detections.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName has_any ("User registered security info","Register device","Add registered owner")
detections.tuning: Alert when registration comes soon after a password reset or from a new IP.

detections.name: Impossible travel / concurrent-country success
detections.summary: Same account, successful sign-ins from more than one country in a short window.
detections.query: SigninLogs | where ResultType==0 | summarize countries=make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)) by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated,1h) | where array_length(countries) > 1
detections.tuning: Exclude VPN egress ranges; pair with the built-in impossible-travel alert.

detections.name: Office app spawns a shell
detections.summary: Weaponized-document execution: Word/Excel/Outlook spawning a shell.
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
detections.tuning: Near-zero false positives in most estates — good candidate for a hard alert.

detections.name: Encoded / obfuscated PowerShell
detections.summary: Base64/download-cradle PowerShell invocations.
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName=~"powershell.exe" | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","-w hidden","IEX","DownloadString","Net.WebClient")
detections.tuning: Some admin tooling uses -nop; the base64/download combos are the sharp signals.

detections.name: LSASS credential dumping
detections.summary: comsvcs.dll MiniDump of lsass.exe (and EDR OpenProcess from non-security procs).
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24")
detections.tuning: Allow-list legitimate crash/diagnostic tooling; alert on the rest.

detections.name: Scheduled task persistence
detections.summary: schtasks /create with a temp/appdata or encoded payload.
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName=~"schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/create" | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell","http","\\temp\\","-enc")   // also Windows Event ID 4698
detections.tuning: Name mimicry + a temp/appdata payload = high confidence.

detections.name: Security tool tampering
detections.summary: Disabling EDR/AV right before detonation.
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring","sc stop","net stop","taskkill") | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Sense","WinDefend","MsMpEng","CrowdStrike","csagent","Sophos","SentinelOne","cylance")
detections.tuning: Any hit here is high severity.

detections.name: Shadow-copy / backup deletion
detections.summary: Fires seconds before encryption — the best chance to stop impact.
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vssadmin delete shadows","vssadmin resize shadowstorage","wmic shadowcopy delete","wbadmin delete catalog","bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no")
detections.tuning: Legitimate backup software rarely uses these verbs interactively — alert hard.

detections.name: Mass file modification (active encryption)
detections.summary: A single process modifying hundreds of files in minutes.
detections.query: DeviceFileEvents | where ActionType=="FileModified" | summarize touched=dcount(FileName) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp,5m) | where touched > 500
detections.tuning: Threshold varies by role (dev boxes churn files); baseline first. Pairs with a canary-file trap.

detections.name: Cloud exfil before encryption
detections.summary: rclone usage or egress to consumer file-share hosts (double extortion).
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName=~"rclone.exe" or ProcessCommandLine has "rclone"   // network: RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","anonfiles.com","transfer.sh","gofile.io","tmpfiles.org")
detections.tuning: rclone on a workstation is almost always malicious — alert.

detections.name: Web server process spawns a shell
detections.summary: IIS/Apache/Tomcat launching cmd/powershell = web-shell or exploit execution.
detections.query: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","java.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe") | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe")
detections.tuning: Very high fidelity — a web worker process should almost never spawn a shell.

detections.name: Web-shell file dropped in a web root
detections.summary: A web worker process writing a new script file into a web directory.
detections.query: DeviceFileEvents | where FolderPath has_any ("\\inetpub\\wwwroot","\\wwwroot","\\htdocs","\\webapps") | where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".jsp" or FileName endswith ".php" or FileName endswith ".ashx" | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","java.exe","php-cgi.exe")
detections.tuning: Exclude legitimate deployment pipelines; a web process writing a new script file is suspect.

detections.name: Risky sign-in then lateral movement (<1h)
detections.summary: A flagged sign-in FOLLOWED BY that account moving laterally — the story, not one login.
detections.query: let risky=SigninLogs | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium") | project riskyUser=tolower(tostring(split(UserPrincipalName,"@")[0])), riskTime=TimeGenerated; DeviceLogonEvents | where LogonType in ("RemoteInteractive","Network") | project LogonTime=Timestamp, acct=tolower(AccountName), DeviceName, RemoteIP | join kind=inner risky on $left.acct==$right.riskyUser | where LogonTime between (riskTime .. riskTime+1h)
detections.tuning: Normalize UPN vs SAM before joining; scope to sensitive hosts to cut noise.

detections.name: Phishing click then shell on same device (<30m)
detections.summary: Crosses email security and endpoint — the seam single-table hunts miss.
detections.query: UrlClickEvents | where ActionType=="ClickAllowed" | project ClickTime=Timestamp, user=tolower(tostring(split(AccountUpn,"@")[0])), Url | join kind=inner (DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe") and FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","rundll32.exe") | project ExecTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, user=tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), FileName, ProcessCommandLine) on user | where ExecTime between (ClickTime .. ClickTime+30m)
detections.tuning: UPN/SAM normalization required; tune the browser/interpreter lists to your estate.

detections.name: New MFA device then inbox rule (<6h)
detections.summary: BEC signature: attacker registers own MFA, then hides replies with a mail rule.
detections.query: let mfa=AuditLogs | where OperationName has_any ("registered security info","Register device") | project mfaTime=TimeGenerated, user=tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)); mfa | join kind=inner (OfficeActivity | where Operation in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules") | project ruleTime=TimeGenerated, user=tolower(UserId)) on user | where ruleTime between (mfaTime .. mfaTime+6h)
detections.tuning: Exclude admin-managed rule changes; the self-registration + rule combo is the tell.

detections.name: Shadow-copy delete then mass file mod (<30m)
detections.summary: Two-signal ransomware confirmation — either alone false-positives, together near-certain.
detections.query: let tamper=DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vssadmin delete shadows","wmic shadowcopy delete","wbadmin delete catalog","bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no") | project tamperTime=Timestamp, DeviceName; tamper | join kind=inner (DeviceFileEvents | where ActionType=="FileModified" | summarize touched=dcount(FileName) by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp,5m) | where touched>300 | project encTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, touched) on DeviceName | where encTime between (tamperTime .. tamperTime+30m)
detections.tuning: Very high confidence; wire to automated host isolation if available.

detections.name: LSASS access then rare external egress (<15m)
detections.summary: Credential theft immediately followed by the host phoning out.
detections.query: let dump=DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24") | project dumpTime=Timestamp, DeviceName; dump | join kind=inner (DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemoteIPType=="Public" and ActionType=="ConnectionSuccess" | project netTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl) on DeviceName | where netTime between (dumpTime .. dumpTime+15m)
detections.tuning: Allow-list known egress; the pairing is the signal, not the connection alone.

detections.name: Endpoints that went dark (EDR telemetry stopped)
detections.summary: A host active for 30 days but silent for 24h — agent killed or host gone. Your blind-spot map.
detections.query: let recent=DeviceInfo | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(24h)) | distinct DeviceName; let reporting=DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | distinct DeviceName; recent | where DeviceName !in (reporting)
detections.tuning: Exclude decommissioned assets via CMDB; alert on unexpected silence.

detections.name: Log source silence (data source stopped ingesting)
detections.summary: If a table stops flowing, every detection built on it is silently dead.
detections.query: Heartbeat | summarize lastBeat=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer | where lastBeat < ago(1h) | order by lastBeat asc   // Sentinel-wide: Usage | summarize max(TimeGenerated) by DataType | where < ago(3h)
detections.tuning: Set per-source thresholds by expected cadence.

detections.name: MITRE tactic coverage inventory (find the zeros)
detections.summary: Which ATT&CK tactics have never fired an alert — your uncovered flanks.
detections.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | mv-expand tactic=todynamic(Tactics) | summarize alerts=count(), rules=dcount(AlertName) by tostring(tactic) | order by alerts asc
detections.tuning: Cross-reference against the full tactic list; a tactic absent = zero coverage.

detections.name: Noisy rules driving alert fatigue
detections.summary: The rules burying analysts — alert fatigue is why real detections get ignored.
detections.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize volume=count() by AlertName | order by volume desc | take 15
detections.tuning: Tune or suppress the top offenders; measure precision, not just volume.

detections.name: First-ever execution of a binary on a host
detections.summary: Flags any executable never before seen on that device in the last 30 days.
detections.query: let baseline=DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d)) | distinct DeviceName, FileName; DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(1d) | join kind=leftanti baseline on DeviceName, FileName
detections.tuning: Noisy on patch days; pair with signer reputation to prioritize.

detections.name: User file access above their own 30-day norm
detections.summary: Deviation from each user's OWN baseline — catches staging/insider/ransom prep and AI-tempo bulk collection (C0062).
detections.query: let perUser=DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d)) and ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified") | summarize dailyAvg=count()/29.0 by acct=InitiatingProcessAccountName; DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp > ago(1d) and ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified") | summarize today=count() by acct=InitiatingProcessAccountName | join kind=inner perUser on acct | where today > 3*dailyAvg and today > 500
detections.tuning: The clearest AI-tempo signal; baseline per role to reduce noise.

detections.name: Low-prevalence, regular-interval egress (beaconing)
detections.summary: Beacons hide in low volume but betray themselves through regularity.
detections.query: DeviceNetworkEvents | where ActionType=="ConnectionSuccess" and RemoteIPType=="Public" | summarize hits=count(), hours=dcount(bin(Timestamp,1h)), span=max(Timestamp)-min(Timestamp) by RemoteUrl, DeviceName | where hours >= 6 and hits < 200 | extend regularity=todouble(hours)/(hits+1) | where regularity > 0.5 | order by regularity desc
detections.tuning: Allow-list known SaaS/telemetry beacons; jitter defeats naive cadence — combine with rare-destination scoring.
